name: studypilot
description: StudyPilot — AI-powered personal learning coach (monorepo root)

scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory services/api python -m uvicorn app.main:create_app --factory --reload --port 8000 --no-access-log
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: uv run --directory services/api python -m ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --directory services/api python -m ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --directory services/api python -m ruff format --check .
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
